description: Every reading Hermoso took of one of the brand's published posts, oldest first, with the numbers exactly as the platform reported them at that moment (a failed reading stays in the list as a failure, never as zeros), and one row per day. Posts are read about 24 hours and 7 days after they go out; open a tracking window (manage_post_tracking) to read one daily for up to 90 days. Read-only, 0 credits.

brand.description: profile id/name from list_brands, this call only

postId.description: The post record id, the platform post id, or the post link
